security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: 2D vector design and animation for humans and AI agents
bundle.longDescription: RaveAnima is a desktop editor for 2D vector graphics and keyframe animation. Every tool is a command that AI agents can run through MCP. Exports Lottie, MP4, GIF, WebM, SVG and PNG.
